_comment: Per-FILE line-count baselines moved to docs/doc-size/ (one <path>.size file each, LA-33) — a single shared map made every pair of PRs conflict on the same two lines. What stays here is the entries-directory policy, which is one rule about a whole directory rather than a number per file, so splitting it would buy nothing. Reasoning for any change goes in docs/doc-size-baseline-history.md, not here.
